offering_description.value: Trulieve sells cannabis products to medical patients, adult-use consumers, and licensed retailers. It grows and processes cannabis and sells it primarily through its own dispensaries, with wholesale distribution in select markets.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; pre-rolls; vape cartridges; concentrates; edibles

customer_segment.value: B2C: medical cannabis patients and adult-use cannabis consumers; B2B: licensed cannabis retailers buying wholesale inventory

revenue_model.value: product sales: retail and wholesale purchases of cannabis flower and processed cannabis products

value_chain_position.value: retailer: stocks cannabis products for sale to patients and adult-use consumers through company-operated dispensaries; OEM / manufacturer: grows cannabis and processes it into packaged products for its dispensaries and licensed retailers; distributor: supplies packaged cannabis products to licensed third-party retailers in select states; asset operator: operates cultivation, processing, and dispensary facilities serving retail and wholesale customers
value_chain_position.category: retailer; OEM / manufacturer; distributor; asset operator

geography_served.value: US regional: Florida is the largest market, with operations also in states including Arizona, Pennsylvania, Maryland, and Georgia

specialization.value: related lines: cannabis flower, pre-rolls, vapes, concentrates, and edibles for medical and adult-use markets

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated medical and adult-use dispensaries; online: online ordering for dispensary pickup or home delivery where available; direct sales: wholesale sales to licensed dispensaries; third-party retail: independent licensed dispensaries carrying its products in select markets
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; direct sales; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state licensing and oversight of cannabis cultivation, processing, and sales, with federal controlled-substance rules also applying

notes: The exact current state footprint is uncertain.
